mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_execution (job_id, plugin_id, instance_id, status, trigger_type, job_name, runner_log_path) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{pluginId}, #{instanceId}, #{status}, #{triggerType}, #{jobName}, #{runnerLogPath})
mapper.update: UPDATE job_execution SET request_id = #{requestId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM job_execution
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM job_execution WHERE started_at >= #{startTime} AND started_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE(started_at) AS bucket_date, status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM job_execution WHERE started_at >= #{startTime} AND started_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(started_at), status ORDER BY bucket_date ASC, status ASC
